trials.claim: Lifetime access to EzyCommunity tier for the life of the product with no recurring fee
trials.claimQuote: Yes. Your AppSumo tier is yours for the life of the product, including all future updates to that plan, with no recurring software fee.
trials.reasoning: The terms allow the vendor to suspend or terminate access at any time, with or without notice, for any reason, which materially limits the promise of access for the life of the product.

exhibits.quote: the Services are licensed to you, not sold, and you may only use them as permitted under these Terms;
exhibits.argument: Lifetime claim is undermined because access is only a revocable license, not ownership.

exhibits.quote: We may suspend or terminate your access to the Services at any time, with or without notice, for any reason, including violation of these Terms.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can end access at any time for any reason, contradicting guaranteed lifetime access.

trials.claimQuote:
2,000 Members

trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so the Tier 2 limits cannot be checked either way.

trials.claim: All future updates to the purchased plan are included
trials.claimQuote: including all future updates to that plan, with no recurring software fee.
trials.reasoning: The terms allow termination of access at any time for any reason, which materially limits the promise that all future updates to the plan will be included.

exhibits.quote: We may suspend or terminate your access to the Services at any time, with or without notice, for any reason, including violation of these Terms.
exhibits.argument: Promise of all future updates is void if vendor can terminate access entirely at any time.

exhibits.quote: THE SERVICES ARE PROVIDED “AS IS” AND “AS AVAILABLE,” WITHOUT WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND, WHETHER EXPRESS, IMPLIED, OR STATUTORY
exhibits.argument: No warranty of continued functionality undermines guarantee that future updates will be provided.

trials.claimQuote: AppSumo customers are covered by AppSumo's standard 60-day money-back guarantee.
trials.reasoning: The non-refundable term allows exceptions expressly stated, and the 14-day trial shown is for ordinary pricing, not evidence about AppSumo buyers; no exhibit directly confirms the 60-day guarantee.

exhibits.quote: Fees are billed in advance on a recurring basis unless otherwise stated, and are non-refundable except as required by law or as expressly stated
exhibits.argument: Terms state fees are non-refundable by default, limiting the advertised 60-day guarantee.

exhibits.quote: All plans include 0% transaction fees and a 14-day free trial. No card required to start.
exhibits.argument: Official pricing advertises only a 14-day trial, not 60 days, contradicting the refund coverage claim.

trials.claim: Can upgrade to higher tier or contact support about custom plan if outgrow limits
trials.claimQuote: You can upgrade to a higher AppSumo tier while it's available, or contact EzyCommunity support about a custom plan.
trials.reasoning: The cited pricing and Agency Program terms do not address upgrading an AppSumo tier or contacting support for a custom plan, and no exhibit confirms that option.

exhibits.quote: EzyCommunity reserves the right to establish, modify, or enforce minimum pricing requirements at any time.
exhibits.argument: Custom plan pricing is not freely negotiable and can be changed or enforced by vendor at any time.

exhibits.quote: Failure to comply with these pricing policies may result in suspension or termination of Agency Program participation.
exhibits.argument: Attempting to upgrade or get custom pricing can lead to suspension if vendor deems pricing non-compliant.
